summary: The exact frozen composition is scientifically conservative and all nine tests pass, but a valid fractional candidate width breaches the documented singleton-bank search contract. Source arange uses ceil((end-start)/step): [31.01,31.01+1,1] enumerates31.01 and32.010000000000005. On a nominal34/occupied33-row stripe with bank[31.01] and tolerance1, the wrapper exposes width33 and observed midpoint using unintended32.01; a direct requested31.01 edge pair returns null. Fix or explicitly constrain the singleton seam before acceptance. All11 candidate/guard/source SHA256 values and four Git blobs match; ten input guard falsifiers fail closed, signed midpoint and copied-source integrity tests pass. CLI preserves hidden nonfinite rows. Local width and semantic identity remain UNKNOWN throughout.

findings.finding: All11 frozen file SHA256 values and four immutable-source Git blobs match before/after execution. Ten frame/hash/nonfinite/bank/mask/id invalid-input controls return UNKNOWN before source operations. Own copied vendor tamper throws source-integrity error.

Forward/reverse headings preserve candidate-center-minus-fit-midpoint=-cPx; nominal-width normalization is explicitly labelled. Dev72 dimensionless scores and bilinear profile gradient units are distinct, with separate sampling seam and no agreement confidence claim.

Arbitrary imageId/geometrySource claims remain caller provenance and do not promote semantic identity. Empty and all-hidden evidence preserve raw numerical defaults; calibrated width remains null. CLI serializes -Infinity with numberKind tag.

limits: No C2 heldout/evaluator access; this is independent source review with exposed reviewer fixtures, not course evaluation.
Only bounded160x160 rasters and40-station profile windows executed. Finite input validation does not establish a practical resource envelope for arbitrarily large rasters/windows/banks.
Top-level null input throws before validation; documented object-shaped input is the supported domain reviewed. This is an explicit unsupported-input limit, not the scientific amendment.
Frame strings and supplied occluder/geometry provenance cannot verify physical coordinate correctness; exact RGBA hash binds bytes only.
